message: The other day, I found myself in a situation where I was finally the prepared one! I had just finished organizing our go-bags with snacks, water, and important documents when a sudden storm warning popped up on my phone. Instead of scrambling around like I usually do, I felt a sense of calm knowing we were ready. It’s funny how a little bit of planning can turn chaos into comfort. What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared at home?
